sessions.topic: Graph-predicted face mobilities meet the initial branching-case thresholds
sessions.boundary_reason: The initial evaluation ends with a decision and report; the next discussion audits that report.

sessions.topic: Audit reveals mass imbalance caused by saturation clipping
sessions.boundary_reason: The audit identifies a defect; the next discussion tests a replacement for clipping.

sessions.topic: Shared-face flux limiting restores post-update conservation
sessions.boundary_reason: The limiter test concludes before a shift to a multiscale pressure-basis approach.

sessions.topic: Multiscale pressure bases conserve mass but miss the breakthrough target
sessions.boundary_reason: The initial multiscale evaluation ends; the next discussion investigates its breakthrough error.

sessions.topic: One-cell-neck bases improve initial multiscale breakthrough accuracy
sessions.boundary_reason: The initial neck-base test concludes before an ablation on new cases.

sessions.topic: New branching cases lead to deferral of neck-base multiscale surrogate
sessions.boundary_reason: The deferral closes this approach before a projected-flux proposal.

sessions.topic: Projected fluxes are compared with neck bases on junction and branching cases
sessions.boundary_reason: The comparison finds projected-flux errors above target; the next test examines a different junction class.

sessions.topic: Projected fluxes meet thresholds on unseen X-junctions
sessions.boundary_reason: The X-junction result prompts a separate investigation of connectivity-dependent errors.

sessions.topic: Connectivity-error atlas examines necks, junctions, and flux splits
sessions.boundary_reason: The atlas is produced before a proposal to use its measures in training.

sessions.topic: Split-weighted flux supervision meets thresholds on mixed connectivity cases
sessions.boundary_reason: The mixed-case audit concludes before a high-contrast neck stress test.

sessions.topic: High-contrast neck failures lead to deferral of split-weighted fluxes
sessions.boundary_reason: The deferral closes this approach before an adaptive pressure-patch proposal.

sessions.topic: Adaptive neck-pressure patches improve high-contrast breakthrough accuracy
sessions.boundary_reason: The first patch test concludes before evaluation on fresh multi-neck networks.

sessions.topic: Fresh multi-neck results support selecting adaptive pressure patches
sessions.boundary_reason: The selection decision precedes broader validation on other unseen networks.

sessions.topic: Broader validation produces the Braided-300 evaluation bundle
